current.text: He re-signed with Minnesota on a minimum contract as guard depth.
He is expected to be a bench scoring option, but Ben calls him a roll of the dice.
He was solid enough when he had to start.
Minnesota's four set starters are LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards, Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert. Jonathan Kuminga and Josh Green are the names for the fifth spot.
Minnesota is short on guards: Donte DiVincenzo will miss most of the season and Mike Conley is gone.
Minnesota's bench is thin, has little scoring punch and has no ball handlers.
Minnesota has a two-game week in the matchup starting March 15, which is week 20 of our fantasy playoffs.
Minnesota should be competitive. Ben predicts 53 wins, so the team should not rest players to tank.
He is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. He is a waiver option only if his bench role grows.

note: Hyland is not a draft pick for us. Yahoo ranks him 235, ESPN ranks him 283, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he went undrafted in our league last season. His projected line of about 8 points and 1.5 threes in 16 minutes has no strong category apart from a modest turnover edge. Watch him on waivers early in the season, because Minnesota's bench has no ball handlers and DiVincenzo is out, so he only has value if he takes on a bigger role. The two-game week starting March 15 also lowers his value in the fantasy playoffs.
